description: Search live federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov, newest-modified first. Filter by keyword, NAICS codes, set-aside codes (e.g. SBA, 8A, HZC, SDVOSBC, WOSB), and notice types (e.g. 'Sources Sought'). The public index applies those filters after fetch, so a filtered search pages deeper (up to 10 pages / 1,000 records) until the filter is satisfied — the response reports pages_fetched, how many records were examined (fetched), and scan_truncated when the page budget ran out. Returns the SAM index total and the post-filter count.

notice_types.description: Notice types to require, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ['Sources Sought']

size.description: Index records per page (1-100, default 100); also the post-filter target a filtered scan pages toward

name: contracts_search_opportunities
